user.title: Watch Tesla inventory
user.description: Configure your search and notifications. A Chrome-compatible client checks Tesla at most once every 8 hours (3 times per day per search). The first check runs after saving; a Tesla refusal appears in the integration status.

init.title: Tesla Inventory Watch options
init.description: Checks remain limited to once every 8 hours, including errors and restarts. Changing filters silently resets the VIN baseline at the next permitted check.
